thesis: The thesis is intact. CROX re-rated on the 2026-10-29 Q3 print (net income +48.65% YoY, forward P/E about 10), it is still holding above the 149.5 post-earnings base, and it is up about 2.5% today (intraday.last 162.79 vs 158.79 prior close) even though the regime is risk-off. Today's news (the Zacks international-sales recap) adds nothing new. The rating moves from Overweight to Hold on price, not on a broken thesis. At the last price, R/R to the 178.98 target with the 148.8 stop is only 1.16 (16.19 up vs 13.99 down), below the 1.5 floor. That triggers lesson 1 (downgrade to Hold when R/R at the last price is below 1.5). Price also sits 0.9% under the 164.24 52-week high, which was rejected again today at 164.07, and is 10.3% above SMA20. Stop and target are unchanged from the technical card. The entry zone moves up to the card's 157.0-161.0, which gives R/R of 1.96 at the 159.0 midpoint, so a pullback into the zone, or a close above 164.24 on expanding volume, would justify going back to Overweight. Today's low of 156.10 traded inside the morning zone (154.5-158.5), so a morning fill at or below 156.5 is plausible. Any such fill should be logged and held with the 148.8 stop, with no adds at 162.79. There was no debate this session (preclose re-assessment), and news and SEC feeds were available.
invalidation: Daily close below 149.5 (the post-earnings base low), or a failure back under the 150 gap area on rising volume.
key_risks: Risk-off regime (confidence 0.85, QQQ 21-day return -8.55%, TNX 5.115) with Fed-hike repricing hitting a beta-1.5, leveraged name (total debt 1.66B vs cash 163M)
Double rejection near the 164.24 52-week high (11-16 high 164.24, today's high 164.07) while volume is soft (vol_ratio 0.90, partial bar 505k)
Extended: 10.3% above SMA20, RSI 68.8, and the price is about at the analyst mean target of 164.67
Earnings growth (+48.65%) far outpaces revenue growth (+4.65%), and the packet has no guidance detail
